recipe.visualDefinition: A full-body studio portrait of a young woman centered against a neutral, off-white gradient background. She wears a vibrant red and orange plaid shirt tucked into dark, high-waisted jeans. Bold, condensed serif typography spans the top third of the frame, partially obscured by the subject's head to create depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's head overlaps the primary display text to establish foreground/background hierarchy.
The warm tones of the plaid shirt coordinate with the pinkish-red hue of the main title.
The verticality of the condensed typeface mirrors the tall, standing posture of the subject.
coreInvariants: Neutral, high-key studio background with subtle floor-to-wall transition.
Full-body framing with hands on hips or in pockets.
Primary text split into two distinct blocks flanking the subject's head.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered, full-length figure occupying approximately 75% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the large-scale typography at the top of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold red text, moves down to the face, follows the vertical line of the body to the shoes, and returns to the smaller arched text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample breathing room on the left and right sides of the subject, emphasizing the studio setting.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Pink-Red (Primary Text) and Orange/Yellow (Plaid pattern)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject's clothing and text against a low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure white; use warm-toned neutrals.
Limit text colors to two high-contrast hues.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely high stroke contrast between thick verticals and hairline horizontals.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' features tight curves and sharp terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast Didone for the name paired with a sturdy, smaller Slab Serif for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme verticality and high contrast of the primary text.
Provides the necessary weight and structure for the arched subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a full-body studio portrait of a woman with 1980s-style voluminous hair, wearing a red/orange plaid button-down shirt and dark high-waisted jeans, standing against a seamless cream-colored studio backdrop. Ensure the top 25% of the frame is clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place the primary name in a bold, pink-red extra-condensed serif font across the top, splitting the words so the subject's head is in the center. Add the secondary title in a dark navy slab serif, arched slightly above the primary text.

verificationChecks: Is the subject's head overlapping the main text?
Is the primary font a high-contrast condensed serif?
Is the background a clean, warm-toned studio gradient?

adjustableVariables: Hue of the primary display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subject

mustAchieve: Clean studio lighting with soft shadows
avoid: Modern digital filters that obscure the 80s film look

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible despite the overlap.
Ensure the color of the text complements the clothing.
Verify the full-body framing includes the shoes.
Confirm the '80s aesthetic' is maintained through hair and fashion choices.
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Split Condensed Serif Header + Arched Subtitle + High-Waisted Fashion
